title: Rewrite block_details_screen.dart to new design system
instructions:
Rewrite lib/ui/carnivalBlock/blockDetails/widgets/block_details_screen.dart using the new design system primitives. Pattern: DETAIL with ownership + members list + actions.

**Cubit (DO NOT MODIFY):** BlockDetailsCubit(carnivalBlocksRepository, getCurrentUserData, carnivalBlockId) is already wired in lib/routing/router.dart. Constructor signature MUST stay identical.

**States (sealed-class pattern, match with switch/is):** BlockDetailsInitial, BlockDetailsLoading, BlockDetailsLoaded(carnivalBlock, currentMemberId, currentMemberRole, canManageMembers), BlockDetailsError(message).

**Widgets to use:** AppAppBar, AppLoading, AppError, AppEmpty, AppCard (for sections: cover, info, members), AppSectionHeader, AppListTile, AppButton, MemberCard, AppFAB (for 'Nova reunião' or 'Adicionar membro' when canManage).

**Layout guidance:**
1. Cover image at top - use CachedNetworkImage (same style as BlockCard) wrapped in AppCard, image from carnivalBlock.coverImageUrl. Fall back to colored placeholder if null.
2. Title below cover - AppTypography.headlineSmall (Fredoka).
3. Info section (AppCard + AppSectionHeader 'Informações') with AppListTile rows for description, location, member count, role (use currentMemberRole to render via MemberCard's roleLabel + token color via AppColors.primary/secondary/tertiary).
4. Members section (AppCard + AppSectionHeader 'Membros (N)') rendering each member using MemberCard. When list is empty, render AppEmpty inside the card.
5. FAB (AppFAB) for 'Nova reunião' when canManage - navigates to /create-meeting/:blockId.

**Role color:** Use AppColors.primary/secondary/tertiary directly via tokens. DO NOT import legacy lib/ui/core/colors/role_colors.dart or app_colors.dart (those will be deleted in Batch 2).

**The _getRoleColor warning at line 586 is eliminated automatically** - do NOT preserve it (it was unused).

**Navigation after action:** Delete (when canManage) -> AppDialog.confirm(isDestructive: true) -> call cubit.deleteBlock() -> on success context.pop() + AppSnackbar.info('Bloco removido'). Edit -> push Routes.editBlock/:id.

**Preserve exactly:** constructor signature, sealed-class state matching, all entity field accesses, and any text used in pt-BR (do NOT translate existing strings).
validation: Run `flutter analyze lib/ui/carnivalBlock/blockDetails/widgets/block_details_screen.dart` and confirm 0 issues (the pre-existing _getRoleColor warning must be GONE)
All string literals use double quotes
`MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)` checked before any animation (e.g. AnimatedContainer, Hero, AnimatedSwitcher)
Cubit constructor signature unchanged from router's expectation - BlockDetailsCubit(carnivalBlocksRepository, getCurrentUserData, carnivalBlockId)
Screen widget class name `BlockDetailsScreen` and constructor `const BlockDetailsScreen({super.key})` preserved
NO emojis as icons - Material Symbols Rounded only
Cover image uses CachedNetworkImage with placeholder + error widget
Members section renders MemberCard for each member; empty state via AppEmpty inside the card
Role color uses AppColors tokens (primary/secondary/tertiary), NOT legacy role_colors.dart
